official_statement_rationale: I vote to maintain the repo rate at 6.50%, but I dissent on the stance. The persistence of the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is increasingly inconsistent with the evolving macroeconomic landscape. With core inflation at 3.60%, well below the 4.00% target, the real policy rate is already significantly positive and restrictive. Food inflation at 8.30% is a supply-side phenomenon that cannot be effectively addressed by further monetary tightening. Maintaining a stance that signals a continued withdrawal of accommodation risks overtightening and unnecessarily dampening the 6.80% GVA growth momentum. A shift to a neutral stance is necessary to acknowledge that the current policy rate is sufficiently restrictive to anchor inflation expectations without imposing an avoidable drag on the economy.
